description.value: Osoyoos Desert Centre is a 67-acre nature interpretive facility operated by the Osoyoos Desert Society, showcasing one of Canada's rarest antelope-brush desert ecosystems in the South Okanagan. Visitors explore along a 1.5 km elevated wooden boardwalk with guided or self-guided tours, plus an interpretive building with hands-on exhibits and a native plant demonstration garden. Located just 3 km north of Osoyoos off Highway 97, it makes a compelling stop for cyclists riding through the valley.
